description_en: Queries the change processes of an application
description_zh: 调用ListRecentChangeOrder列出应用历史变更单列表
name: ListRecentChangeOrder

BatchCount.description_en: The number of batches for the change. Valid values: 1 to 5
BatchCount.description_zh: 分批次数。最少1批，最多5批

BatchType.description_en:
The way in which the next batch is triggered during a phased release. Valid values:

Automatic

Manual
BatchType.description_zh:
分批发布时下一批变更的执行方式。

Automatic：自动
Manual：手动

ChangeOrderDescription.description_en: The description of the change process
ChangeOrderDescription.example: Version: 2020-05-14 20:02:33 | Package: hsf-pandora-boot-provider-1.0.jar | Deployment target: All groups

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The unique ID of the change process

CoType.description_en: The type of the change process

CoTypeCode.description_en: The type of the change process
CoTypeCode.description_zh:
变更流程类型：
CoCreateApp：创建应用。
CoStartApplication：启动应用。
CoStopApplication：停止应用。
CoRestartApplication：重启应用。
CoDeleteApp：删除应用。
CoStart：启动应用实例。
CoStop：停止应用实例。
CoRestart：重启实例。
CoDeploy：部署应用。
CoReset：重置应用实例。
CoRollback：回滚应用。
CoScaleIn：缩容应用实例。
CoScaleOut：扩容应用实例。
CoChangeGroup：更改应用实例分组。
CoUpdateContainer：更新应用部署包版本。
CoBindSlb：绑定SLB。
CoBindECSSlb：绑定ECS SLB。
CoUnbindECSSlb：解绑ECS SLB。
CoUnbindSlb：解绑SLB。
CoModifySlb：配置SLB。
CoModifyConfig：修改应用配置。
CoClusterScaleOut：集群扩容。
CoRescaleApplicationVertically：垂直扩缩容

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the change process was created

CreateUserId.description_en: The user who created the change process

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the change process ended

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the application instance group on which the change was performed

Source.description_en:
The source of the change. Valid values:

console: the Enterprise Distributed Application Service (EDAS) console

pop: the POP API or tool
Source.description_zh:
变更来源。
console：EDAS控制台
pop：POP API或工具

Status.description_en:
The state of the change process. Valid values:

0: ready to start execution

1: in progress

2: successful

3: failed

6: terminated

8: waiting for manual confirmation (You can see the state when you manually confirm the execution of the next batch of the change.)

9: waiting for automatic execution

10: failed due to a system error
Status.description_zh:
变更流程状态。
0：准备开始执行
1：执行中
2：执行成功
3：执行失败
6：执行终止
8：等待手工确认（手工分批的时候能看到）
9：等待自动执行
10：由于系统错误而失败

UserId.description_en: The ID of the user who created the change process

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
